decisions.quote: SWA was failing, it is failing, and NASW-P has failed to correct those failures.
decisions.reason: The 2009 original study ('Social Work Abstracts Fails Again') found substantial missing issue coverage in the SWA database, and the replication confirms this finding of database failure with an even higher missingness rate, as explicitly stated in the abstract and title ('A Replication of Failure, Not a Failure to Replicate').
